lines.en: Io and I manage to make our way back out of the tunnel without getting lost or encountering any other suspicious cliffs that lead to perpetual darkness.
She wants to stay together. And I do too.
Was it the most conventional “date” I’ve been on? Obviously not. But it fit her well and, by extension, I guess that means it fit me well too.
There’s somewhere else I need to be, though. With someone else who’s been nothing short of a pillar of my unfortunate existence for as long as I’ve been here.
That pillar is on the precipice of crumbling now, unfortunately.
And it’s one that I imagine will have to come up today if we’re ever going to keep it from collapsing.
I just wonder how the conversation is going to go. And I wonder how much of it is real and not just one more impulse on an ever growing list of things that she regrets.
Io and I say our goodbyes outside of the cafe and she leaves to go meet back up with Uta.
She wants to kiss me again, but I deny her — not wanting to be spotted by my second date, who’s likely watching us from the other side of the window.
I am sure this will not have any negative effect on Io’s already lackluster self-esteem whatsoever.
: Greetings, sir! Welcome to Koi Cafe! Will you be dining in or taking your order to go?
: Excellent! Just so you know, our special for today is “whatever I want to make you.” May I mark you down for one or two?
: And will you be having that hot or iced?
: Got it! Please wait one moment while I get everything ready for you.
: You can go ahead and take a seat if you like. I can promise that if I do use poison, which I will not confirm or deny, it will not be a lethal dose.
: What happened to you?
: Hm? Whatever do you mean, cherished customer?
: I mean you were blonde less than 24 hours ago. And now you’re-
: Beautiful? Cute? Awesome?
: Normal.
: Normal?! I thought I looked pretty good as a blonde!
: You did. You always do. Just this is how I’m used to seeing you, so it’s the established baseline of what “normal” means to me.
: Well, that’s good. Because I did it for you.
: No you didn’t.
: No, I really did. The appointment I was talking about last night was for my hair.
: But you don’t-
: I know I don’t have to do anything and that the color of my hair has virtually no bearing whatsoever on our relationship. But, and hear me out here-
: I think I am tired of changing so much. And I think I am finally ready to commit to one thing for good. And that thing, you may ask?
: Being your homie! Which means returning to my homie roots with homie hair! And you get to be the first one to witness this transformation!
: Besides Haruka since she is also working right now and I needed her help clocking in earlier.
: So, you’re...dedicating yourself to being my friend? And this has nothing to do with your newfound desire to want me to-
: Don’t say it.
: Ahem.
: Don’t do it, Sensei. I know what’s coming.
: Pound you with the intensity of a western silverback.
: Can homies not do things like that together?
: They can, I think. They just don’t normally find out about it from their homie’s mother.
: To be fair — you would have found out about it from me if you actually kept your phone on you. And I’d probably be pregnant right now.
: So you’re just gonna...roll with it? Not get all embarrassed and weird like you do any time you’re talking to someone else you have a crush on?
: I gain flirty super powers when I’m behind this counter. It’s a barista thing. Earns me more tips. Anyway, yeah. That is a thing that happened. But...
: But?
: I was very horny that night. Destructively so. And you know better than most that it is hard to act rationally under such circumstances. Which is why I have a proposal.
: I’m listening.
: Today, we will both go through this entire date wearing blindfolds. That way, the horny will not reach us.
: Proposal rejected.
: Shit. I guess we’ll just have to hang out like normal then and put the homiedom in jeopardy.
: Well, that’s the whole point of a date, isn’t it? Shouldn’t you want to be putting the homiedom in jeopardy right now so you can win the war?
: War?
: Oh! Right, that.
: Yeah, I don’t really care.
: What?
: I’m mostly just excited to hang out with you and I’m using the pretense of the date war as an excuse to do that since we haven’t just chilled in what feels like forever.
: I don’t have anything special planned and don’t mind losing if you don’t wind up choosing me. I just want to spend time with you and make things feel normal again.
: You don’t mind, do you?
: Not at all...I think I’d like that too, actually.
: Cool! I’m gonna go say bye to Haruka and clock out then. She said it’s okay for me to bail whenever. She just wants to know when it happens so she can take over.
: Okay, yeah. I guess I’ll just...wait here then.
: Mhm! Be back in a sec!
Rin disappears into the kitchen and returns with Haruka a minute or two later.
Before I have a chance to greet her and feign an apology for stealing her employee, though, Rin races out from behind the counter and grabs my arm, pulling me to the door.
: Away, homie! I will not let my work mom’s boobs deprive me of the opportunity for quality time!
: Our time together isn’t in jeopardy at all if we just stare at them together.
: Ooh, good point. Haruka — could you jump up and down for us really quick?
: What? No. That’s completely objectifying and-
: Do it.
: Yes, [harukamaster].
I use my powers for evil once more and Haruka has no choice but to obey.
: Woah. Look at ‘em go.
: I have too much power now. This isn’t fair.
Rin and I only spend a good thirty seconds watching Haruka objectify herself before turning around and leaving her there to bounce on her own for the rest of eternity.
: Rin, come on. That’s a married woman you’re talking to.
: But the boobs! You were on my team just a second ago! They must- aah!
I yank Rin by the arm to prove to her that I’m actually a good guy and that the fact that I’m sleeping with basically all of her classmates does not undermine my moral code.
Then, before long, we’re right outside of the dorms. And everything feels somewhat normal again, just...
That normalcy is now laced with the open admission that there are more potent feelings present. Which is something I’ve always had to just assume until now.
It’s not changing her, though. At least not in the ways it historically has. Which makes me unsure of whether or not this is some sort of bluff or...
Maybe I am special?
Because she is to me, right? It’s not just her hair that’s making me nostalgic. It’s all of this.
The cafe banter. That feeling of the air going cold as the lights start to come on outside of the dorms.
That infectious smile and the way her ponytail bounces when she walks.
The subtle glances I get of her ears and the subsequent realization that I’m always forgetting they’re pierced. So it’s like I’m always learning something new about her.
Even after all this time — she’s still not boring. She’s still Rin.
: Sooooo...
But that doesn’t mean she isn’t changing too. I’m just conditioned to believe that change always comes with negatives now.
So this submission and commitment, if that’s really what it is, puts me on edge and makes me want to grab ahold of her hair to stop it from bouncing and just...
Keep her close to me.
: You’re kinda...more quiet than normal.
: Is it the hair? Did I go a little overboard in trying to...go back?
: Why do you want to go back, Rin?
: Hm?
: Are you not happy with the way things have been going? Do you think settling on me is going to make them somehow better?
: Yeah.
: Because you’re the only one I feel like I can be myself with.
: No one else even knows I’ve changed my hair color back yet.
: And I’m sure that’s probably going to make Chika a little sad, but...I realized something yesterday. And I realized it because of her.
: So like, she was in the D&D contest, right? And she didn’t know anything about D&D so, being her friend, she asked me to teach her. And I was like, hell yeah. Let’s go.
: So I did. And it went...mostly well. But during the competition, when I was explaining stuff to her, she looked at me and she said “You’re cute.”
: And I blushed. Obviously. I think I’ll always kind of like her. But, when we got up from the table and went our separate ways, I felt...stupid.
: I spent years hiding my nerdy side from Chika because I didn’t want her to think I was uncool.
: But I never had to do that. Chika’s one of the most accepting people I’ve ever met. And she’s never been anything but nice to me.
: I did it anyway, though. And I did that because, for some reason, I felt like I had to be someone to be with her.
: Same with Otoha. I was always thinking, “Oh my God, she’s so much cooler than me. I can’t show her who I really am.”
: Even super personal stuff like my cutting I couldn’t really talk about with her because it just felt...wrong.
: But with you — none of that’s ever happened. I don’t feel like I need to change or be anyone specific. I can just...be Rin.
: And I think maybe that’s okay now. Maybe I should be Rin. And maybe you should be you and we should both just...be together.
: As friends...homies...something else...whatever.
: I’m trying not to think about it since thinking has never really worked out in my favor.
: Mature, right? Am I finally cool now? Do I finally sound like an adult?
: No. You still sound like a confused teenager.
: Damn. Thought I was finally onto something.
: It is a mature way to look at things, though. Especially by your standards.
: Yeah?
: Yeah...
: It’s just the person you’re aiming those feelings at that makes me question whether or not I should put any stake in this sudden character growth.
: Then be like me. Try not to think about it.
: Lets just...do nothing and see what happens for once.
We’re back in her room, where so much has happened. And for the first time since the last time I held her blood in place, it feels like I’m supposed to be here.
I’m not a buffer now. Not someone for her to bounce her feelings for someone else off of to see how they’ll land. Just someone to sit with and...experience life with.
How long will it stay that way, though?
: See that spot right over there? Where the alarm clock is?
: That’s where I was standing when I got into an argument with my mom about wanting to have sex with you.
: Very cool, Rin.
: And that chair? That’s where I was sitting when I was thinking about having sex with you. And then sending texts about the sex I wanted to have with you to you.
: I’d show you where I was when I found out about all of this, but we’d need to walk halfway across town in order to do that. And I don’t think your mom would appreciate it.
: I kinda figured she was going to tell you.
: I’m...really sorry about that. I’m not trying to, like...blow up your spot or anything. I know the last thing you need is people being suspicious about...you know.
: She’ll find out even worse eventually. Everyone will. It’s only a matter of time.
: Did she, like...like obviously she wouldn’t give you her blessing. But did she want you to like...talk to me about it? Or...
: I believe I’m supposed to “let you down gently.”
: And?
: And...what?
: Will you?
: Let me down gently.
: Let’s sit on the bed...
: Sensei...
: Test failed.
: What?
: Asking you to sit on the bed with me just seconds after talking about how I want to bone you was a test on whether or not you’re going to let me down at all. And you’re not.
: You love me too much. You’d never hurt your homie.
: At least not nowadays. Not now that the guilt of having already hurt your homie has eaten away at you.
: You’ve had no problem letting me down gently, though. Multiple times too.
: Are you telling me you’ve wanted me this whole time? And that our entire friendship is built upon your desire to one day claim my boy-virginity?
: Not all of it. But I’d obviously be lying if I said I wasn’t frequently masturbating to you behind the scenes.
: That’s okay. It’s not as bad as me masturbating to you behind a curtain while you finger Sana.
: You should have joined in.
: I prefer my Sensei fully conscious, thank you very much.
: You really are comfortable with me, huh?
: I’d be more comfortable if you’d let me crawl inside of your skin and live there.
: Okay. You might be too comfortable with me when you put it that way.
: Yeah. I guess my flirting could use a little work. Can’t exactly look up any nice pick-up lines without a phone, though.
: Do you know when you’re getting it back?
: Another month or two maybe? I just hope I don’t get the Uta treatment and have mine blocked from sending pictures and stuff.
: Wouldn’t want to miss another opportunity to show my family a five minute highlight reel of my masturbation skills.
: I’d be willing to accept a live performance in lieu of a video, just FYI.
: Are homies really homies if they’re not masturbating in front of each other?
: I’m not doing anything like that. I’m just going to sit there and look cool while you go to town on yourself.
: Kinky. We should stop now, though. I’m starting to want you again.
: I thought that was a given now? And what better time than the present?
: We both obviously want this. We’re on a “date.” We’re alone in your room. There’s no reason not to.
: You said it yourself just a little while ago. Let’s just see what happens. Why hold back at all?
: Sensei, just because I can be myself around you and obviously want to do stuff with you doesn’t mean I should.
: I literally just got lectured on how dumb I am for wanting you in the first place. You think I’m dumb for wanting you in the first place.
: That’s why this whole thing is a little confusing to me. You’re such an important person in my life and I don’t want to change that. I just also really want to touch you.
: And I want you to touch me. Everywhere. Until I am sweaty and crying and convulsing from pleasures I have never felt before.
: I want that so much, in fact, that if you were to push me down and have your way with me right now, I would happily oblige and then probably have an orgasm within ten seconds.
: But don’t you want something different?
: What do you mean?
: Don’t you think it’d be nice to have a relationship that doesn’t just flip a switch out of nowhere?
: One that seems impulsive, but is really just the result of two people with undeniable feelings for one another opening themselves up over time?
: Because it’s easy to look at us and think, “Oh — another high schooler with the hots for her teacher,” or “Another creepy, predatorial adult.”
: Hey.
: But if that happens over a long period of time, it’s no longer impulsive at all. It’s sweet and cute and-
: Grooming. What you are referring to is “grooming.”
: Oh. Is that what that means?
: Yes, Rin. And none of it is good. In fact, what you’re suggesting is kind of worse in a way because all people are impulsive.
: And not everyone can see someone as wonderful and special as you and slowly corrupt them over a long period of time.
: Yeah. Good point.
: Guess we can skip all that buildup then and just cut to the part where our tongues are in each other’s mouths.
: Why do you look scared? I’m me. And you’re you. Isn’t that enough?
: Because...
: Because the last time this happened, you forgot about me.
: And I don’t want that to happen a-
: I never forgot about you. Are you serious?
: There has not been a single day since then where you or that moment has slipped by.
: If anything, I’d say it torments me even more because I’m the one who’s had to live with the guilt of depriving us both of something that could have been special.
: It’s not like I would have been loyal to you anyway. Which you probably knew back then. And definitely know now. So calling it something that could have been special-
: You don’t know if that’s the truth, Sensei.  You can’t.
: Like yes, I’d have wanted loyalty. Yes, I’d want you all for myself. But you can’t just assume that you’d make a mistake like that.
: Like, it’s totally 100%% possible that we’d be a happy, monogamous couple to this day if I just kept focusing on you instead.
: If you want to call that a mistake, fine. If you want to call it a regret even, fine!
: But to say I forgot about you ignores the fact that it hurt me too. A lot. And that you will always be my first kiss.
: Now, be my latest too.
: It’s too much. Too good to be true, even. I haven’t earned it. I don’t deserve it. Nothing about this is fair to you.
: And if we kiss here, or do anything else for that matter, all it’ll do is resign you to the same life everyone around you is suffering from.
: So you are letting me down gently then?
: I...don’t know what I’m doing.
: But you’re scared...aren’t you?
: ...yeah.
: I think I might be.
: It’s okay if you are. If you were to put your hand on my chest, I’m sure you’d feel it beating a thousand miles an hour right now.
: I’m not sure if you can measure a heartbeat in distance.
: Well, you’d change your mind if you felt mine. Regardless, this is what I want. You are what I want.
: Though, I...should probably give you the...slight disclaimer that I, once again, think it would be best if we held off on it leading to...other stuff right now.
: I still...want to try and take it slow. You can call it grooming if you want.
: I just think it’ll make for fonder memories if we can look back on this one day and realize how naturally we evolved. From friends to lovers.
: Can you actually love me, Rin? Like really love me? As more than a confidant or homie or teacher or anything like that?
: Don’t you want to find that out together?
: Sensei?...
: If you leave me for the next pretty girl who catches your eye, I will harvest your skull and put it on display in my room.
: That’s the single most romantic thing anyone has ever said to me.
Again, I find myself melting — this time with someone else.
But there is no ledge for my existence to slowly drip from this time, so Rin just has to absorb me.
And I think that, in a sense, she probably already has. And that the reason she’s so comfortable being with me is because a piece of me has already taken root in her.
I just hope it’s a big enough piece that she’s been able to build up an immunity to all of the harm she’ll incur by giving herself to me.
I don’t want to think about that right now, though.
I just want to sit here and do nothing. The same as her. In a place where we can just be ourselves.
Which means-
And I’m sorry to say this-
I’d like for you to leave us alone.
: Mlm...mmnh...mnh!
: Sen...sei...mnch...Sen...sei!
Coffee tastes a little sweeter today.
I wonder why that is?
Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!
